{{Quote|My name is Minn Ishkah, I'm with the Republic Diplomatic Corps.|Minn Ishkah|<ref name="Legacy" />}}
'''Minn Ishkah''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] in the [[Republic Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Republic Diplomatic Corps]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[3625 BBY]], she was present on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] to make diplomatic relations with the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] after the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|imperial]] [[Invasion of Manaan]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|If the Republic truly wants to build an alliance--as Minn constantly insists is the case--then you need to prove it to us.|[[Wo Kasto]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="Legacy" />}}
Minn Ishkah began her career as a special envoy between [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]], [[Havoc Squad]], and the [[Galactic Senate|Republic Senate]]. Her appointment came shortly after an [[Mission to Ando Prime|incident on]] [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]], in which Garza dispatched Havoc Squad without authorization or approval. Soon Ishkah's superiors realized that she had little influence on Garza and got removed from that position.<ref name="CX">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Minn Ishkah}}</ref>

In [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref> after the invasion of Manaan, Ishkah was sent there to form an alliance between the Selkath and the Republic.<ref name="Legacy" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|She likes to surround herself with people who are less-than-ambitious.|[[Dux Akko]]|<ref name="TOR:DA">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|Conversation with Dux Akko}}</ref>}}
With her time spent around General of Republic Special Forces Ishkah seemed to have adopted Garza's brash demeanor and impulsiveness, as well as her opinions on where, when, and how the Republic military should be involved. By the time she was removed from her position, she had formed many close contacts within the military who shared her fervent belief in the Republic's superiority over the Empire.<ref name="CX">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Minn Ishkah}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Minn Ishkah appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|Legacy of the Sith]]'' expansion of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the contact for the Republic bonus series on Manaan.<ref name="Legacy" />

After completing the final mission, "Retribution in the Rift", the player can receive mail from Captain [[Wo Kasto]] expressing his disapproval over a budding relationship forming between Ishkah and his sister, the former Manaan isolationist, [[Mata (biologist)|Mata]].<ref name="Mail">{{TORcite|type=message|Help me with this, please!|Captain Wo Kasto}}</ref>
